# Pollution Control Services

> 24/7 industrial and environmental cleaning in South Africa since 2006: super sucking, high-pressure jetting, desludging, hydraulic bucket winching, vac/jet combination units and hazmat spill response. Level 1 B-BBEE, IWMSA member, 175 staff.

Phone and WhatsApp: 065 145 9199. Email: info@pollcontrols.co.za. Office: Jeffreys Bay, Eastern Cape.

## Services
- [Super sucking](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/pollution-control-services/services/#super-sucking): Our 6-inch liquid ring super sucker trucks clean water treatment plants, wastewater treatment works, pump stations, anaerobic and settling ponds, clarifiers and related infrastructure.
- [High-pressure jetting](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/pollution-control-services/services/#jetting): Hydro jetting clears and maintains sewer lines, stormwater lines and the whole drainage system, restoring flow without digging.
- [Desludging and honey sucking](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/pollution-control-services/services/#desludging): Removal of sludge and waste from septic tanks, conservancy tanks and process tanks, so the system keeps running at full capacity.
- [Hydraulic bucket winching](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/pollution-control-services/services/#bucket-winching): Heavy-duty cleaning of large sewer mains with hydraulic bucket winches, for silt, sand and debris that jetting alone cannot shift.
- [Hydro blasting and vac/jet combination](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/pollution-control-services/services/#vac-jet): One unit that jets and vacuums at the same time, for complex infrastructure where cleaning and removal have to happen together.
- [Hazmat and spill response](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/pollution-control-services/services/#hazmat): A 24-hour hazmat response unit for chemical and oil spills, with spill kits, absorbents, skimmers, bioremediation and chemical cleaners.

## Areas served

- [Western Cape](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/pollution-control-services/areas/western-cape/): Hermanus, Gansbaai, Kleinmond, Plettenberg Bay, Knysna, Cape Town

## Common questions
- Do you offer 24-hour emergency response? Yes. Our hazmat response unit is available 24 hours a day for spills, sewer overflows and blockages. Call or WhatsApp 065 145 9199.
- What is a super sucker? A super sucker is a high-powered vacuum truck. Ours use a 6-inch liquid ring pump and carry 10,000 litres, strong enough to lift thick sludge, grit and settled solids from ponds, clarifiers and pump stations.
- What is the difference between a super sucker and a honey sucker? A honey sucker is built for liquid waste such as septic and conservancy tanks. Ours carry 14,000 litres with B50 vacuum pumps. A super sucker has far more suction for heavy sludge and solids.
- Do you issue safe disposal certificates? Yes. Waste is taken to licensed disposal sites and the paperwork is kept per job.
- Which areas do you cover? We work nationally, with regular work in KwaZulu-Natal (Richards Bay, Empangeni, Durban), the Eastern Cape (Jeffreys Bay, Gqeberha, the Karoo towns) and the Western Cape (Overstrand and Bitou).
- What is your B-BBEE level? Level 1. The business is 51% black women owned and 51% youth owned.
